components.name: site_frontier
components.responsibility: Maintain breadth-first TIL URLs with game affinity, depth, referrer and discovery reason.

components.name: page_classifier
components.responsibility: Classify dialogue transcript, storyline transcript, written lore, developer/external, editorial/index or unknown.

components.name: link_extractor
components.responsibility: Extract same-site candidate links and normalize canonical URLs.

components.name: transcript_parser
components.responsibility: Parse repeated speaker headings, player prompts, responses, stage directions and embedded written items.

components.name: local_store
components.responsibility: Cache raw HTML and normalized transcript JSON outside Git; persist hashes and metadata.

safety: Honor robots/site access rules and rate limits.
Retry transient failures with bounded backoff.
Keep full copyrighted source bodies local; Git stores code, metadata, hashes and provenance.
acceptance_tests: Can resume after interruption without revisiting completed URLs.
A written Morrowind book is not classified as dialogue.
Horn of Jurgen Windcaller is classified as dialogue and speaker turns can be extracted.
Round-robin scheduling moves to another game before recursively exhausting Skyrim.
Duplicate URLs/content hashes do not create duplicate transcript records.
